Name: Forest Farm No Central Ponds
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
This mod removes the central large pond and the small central south pond from the foraging map.

It only edits the pond areas of the map. I made this because I like the vanilla forest farm aesthetic, but I feel that those ponds make it difficult to decorate.

It also makes 2 more tile types diggable (see image below) which make a few more tiles available for crops and therefore more flexible decorating!

I have now added an additional version with all grassy tiles diggable.

Assets extracted from Stardew version 1.5.6 (GOG).
